_comment: Max raw (uncompressed) bytes per manualChunks prefix from vite.config.ts. Prefix matches dist/assets/<prefix>-<hash>.js (and sub-chunks like tanstack-form). Seeded from a real `vite build` on 2026-07-25 with ~15% headroom. Raise deliberately when a chunk legitimately grows; a jump usually means an accidental eager import. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget:check).
_performance_note: The 100 KiB target applies to the Vite entry chunk. The current shared MUI/auth/i18n modulepreload graph is reported separately until the shell dependency split is implemented. PWA precache is bounded independently and must not contain lazy route JavaScript.
